schedule.intro: Each Schedule shows one Scene every week on its days, from its start to its end. Where none plays, the Default Scene does.
schedule.unavailable: this Schedule has no When to edit
schedule.editUnavailable: Editing unavailable: this Schedule has no When.
schedule.noSavedWindow: The saved Schedule has no window in the coming week.
schedule.saved: Saved Schedule {name}. It applies from its next window; a window playing now keeps its end.
schedule.savedNow: Saved Schedule {name} and applied it now: the window playing now finishes and the new rule plays.
schedule.applyNowNote: Save Schedule applies from the next window; the window playing now keeps its end.
schedule.createUnconfirmed: Schedule {name} {unconfirmed} Check the Schedules before saving it again.
schedule.changed: Schedule {name} changed since you opened it.
schedule.changedReload: Schedule {name} changed since you opened it. Reload it to review the saved Schedule.
schedule.staleNote: Reload it to review the saved Schedule; Save Schedule waits until you do.
schedule.removeAccepted: Central removed Schedule {name}. Waiting for the Schedule list to update.
schedule.removeUnknown: Removal outcome for Schedule {name} is unknown. Check the current Schedule before retrying.
schedule.removeRefused: Schedule {name} was not removed: {reason}. Check the current Schedule before retrying.
schedule.dependents: Schedules playing those Scenes also need review:
schedule.untilItEnds: {seconds} s per cycle, keeps playing until its Schedule ends or, when started by hand, until you Finish or Cancel it
schedule.restartHint: Starts the Scene again now. Started again by hand, it has no Schedule end; it {length}.
schedule.replaceNote: Scenes already playing keep what they started with; Schedules that start later use the saved changes.
schedule.adjudication: Later means when Central started it, not the Schedule's start time; Schedules starting at the same moment are put in an order Central fixes.

scene.applyNowNote: Replace Scene applies from the Scene's next start; what plays it now keeps the earlier version.
scene.applyNowTitle: Save Scene {id} and apply it now?
scene.applyNowBody: What plays this Scene now changes to the saved version at once, with a fade over the photo showing.
scene.earlier: Still playing the earlier version of Scene {id}: {names}. Save and apply now changes it at once.
scene.earlierKept: Scene {id} saved, but not applied everywhere: {names} still plays the earlier version, because another Scene keeps its Frames. Save and apply now again once that Scene ends.
scene.savedNowKept: Scene {id} saved, but not applied everywhere.
